description: Browser operations tools for agents sharing one Chromium browser on a device: tab ownership registry, stale tab sweeping, and screen observation (per-tab and full desktop screenshots). An agent host exposes these tools to an agent when the device has no native observation or tab-ownership facilities of its own. Every tool maps 1:1 to a subcommand of the device-side CLI (src/browser_ops.py); the host may invoke the CLI directly, over SSH, or through any transport, and gets back one JSON object per call.

tools.description: Register a browser tab to the calling agent (lane) so other agents know it is owned and the sweeper knows its lifecycle. Two modes: pass url to open a new tab and register it, or pass target_id to claim a tab that is already open. Call this for every tab you open or start using.

owner.description: Stable id of the calling lane or agent, for example x-reaction-replies.

target_id.description: Claim mode: CDP target id of an already open tab.

task.description: Short human readable description of what this tab is for.

url.description: Open mode: URL to open in a new tab and register.

tools.name: tabs_register
tools.output: JSON object: ok, target_id, url, title, owner. Errors if a claimed target does not exist or belongs to another owner.

tools.description: Refresh the heartbeat timestamp on the calling agent's registered tabs. The sweeper closes registered tabs whose heartbeat is older than the configured stale window (default 45 minutes), so long running lanes should heartbeat periodically while their tabs are still in use.

target_id.description: Optional: heartbeat only this tab. Default: all of the owner's tabs.

tools.name: tabs_heartbeat
tools.output: JSON object: ok, owner, heartbeats_updated, at.

tools.description: Mark the calling agent's registered tabs as done. Done tabs are eligible for immediate closing by the sweeper. Marking done is a promise that the tab is no longer needed.

target_id.description: Optional: mark only this tab done. Default: all of the owner's tabs.

tools.name: tabs_mark_done
tools.output: JSON object: ok, owner, marked_done, at.

tools.description: List the whole shared browser state: every registered tab with its owner, task, opened time, last heartbeat, done flag, and its live URL and title read from the browser right now, plus every unregistered page tab (owned by nobody) with its live URL and title. Use this to SEE which tab is which before acting, instead of guessing from a raw URL list.
tools.name: tabs_list
tools.output: JSON object: ok, page_tab_count, registered array, unregistered_pages array.

tools.description: Close only the calling agent's own registered tabs and remove their registry entries. Never closes a tab owned by anyone else or an unregistered tab. If these are the browser's last page tabs, a blank tab is opened first so the browser is never left with zero tabs.
tools.name: tabs_close_mine
tools.output: JSON object: ok, owner, closed array of target ids.

tools.description: Run the sweeper once: close registered tabs that are marked done or whose owner heartbeat is stale beyond the configured window (default 45 minutes), prune registry entries for tabs that no longer exist, and log every action to the sweep log. Hard safety: never closes an unregistered tab, never closes a tab with a fresh heartbeat, and never leaves the browser with zero tabs.
tools.name: tabs_sweep_now
tools.output: JSON object: ok, closed array of {target_id, owner, reason}, pruned array, kept array, remaining_page_tabs.

tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of one specific browser tab, identified by its CDP target id, so the agent can look at the actual tab before acting on it. Works on background tabs. The host returns the local path of the downloaded PNG so the agent can view it.

target_id.description: CDP target id, from tabs_list or tabs_register.

tools.name: screen_capture_tab
tools.output: JSON object: ok, target_id, path (device side; the host wrapper also prints local_path after download), bytes, title, url.

tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the device's whole desktop (all monitors). Implemented through a scheduled task running in the interactive desktop session, because a remote shell session cannot capture the screen on Windows. The host returns the local path of the downloaded PNG.
tools.name: screen_capture_desktop
tools.output: JSON object: ok, path (device side; the host wrapper also prints local_path after download), bytes.
